g1.title: Meet in Public Places
g1.desc: Always arrange your first meetup in a well-lit, public location like a café, mall, or popular tourist spot. Avoid secluded areas or private residences.

g2.title: Review profile information
g2.desc: A verification state is information reported by the service, not a guarantee. Meet in public and report concerns.

g3.title: Share Your Plans
g3.desc: You can save trusted contacts, but this build does not send them your live location or emergency messages. Tell someone you trust about your meetup plans.

g4.title: Control Your Transport
g4.desc: Always be in control of how you get to and from the meetup. Do not rely entirely on the companion for transportation.

g5.title: Keep Chat on CoBuddy
g5.desc: Do not move your conversation to WhatsApp or SMS before meeting. Our chat filters protect you from scams and inappropriate content.

weveBuiltCobuddyToBe: We've built CoBuddy to be a safe community, but personal safety starts with you. Please follow these essential guidelines.
